# MoliTodo

> AI-powered floating desktop task manager. Making task management simple, intelligent, and efficient. 100% local storage, open source and free.

## About

MoliTodo is an open source, AI-powered floating desktop task manager built with Electron, Vue 3, and SQLite. It lives on the edge of your screen as a floating icon with a task count badge — click to open the task panel, or pop individual tasks into independent floating windows. All data is stored locally in SQLite with zero cloud dependency, no telemetry, and no tracking.

Key capabilities: AI task generation from natural language (supports OpenAI, Gemini, Claude, Grok), one-click daily/weekly work reports, calendar (day/week/month), kanban board, list views, recurring tasks, time tracking, local REST API server for AI agents and automation, multiple themes, statistics with activity heatmap, and JSON import/export.

Available for macOS and Windows. Licensed under MIT.

- [LLM Wiki](https://llmwiki.eztoolab.com) — AI-powered personal knowledge compiler (Obsidian plugin + Claude Code Skill)
